description: List the people in the signed-in person's Typeza circle, newest first. For each: the name the person knows them by (null when none is set), their label (partner, friend, family, colleague or other) when set, their Typeza type when they have one, the relationship type between the two (name, tagline, category, a sentence saying who is on which side, the relation page, the pair article on typeza.ai and whether the person's full write-up of it is open) when both have a type, and person_url, the page on typeza.ai for that relationship, where the full write-up can also be opened. Call it when the person asks about the people in their life on Typeza or how they get along with someone in their circle. Needs their Typeza account connected with the relationships permission. It never contains anyone's email, answers or interview text. Duality is the relation for partners and friends; when the question is about work, talk about business relations. This describes typical patterns between types, not advice or a prediction for a real relationship: always pass on the disclaimer. When the circle is empty, offer get_my_invite_link.
